own_constructive_route.normal_basis: For a full simplicial cell, the inward score-difference normals form a genuine basis B.
own_constructive_route.smooth_derivative: D rho_N is a sum of nonnegative coefficients a_Nj times innerSL(B_j), by the smooth-transition product rule.
own_constructive_route.bounded_Stein: Expanding fixed smooth cutoffs have derivative bound C/R. Dominated convergence extends the actual Gaussian integration-by-parts identity to each bounded smooth rho_N with bounded derivative.
own_constructive_route.coefficient_recovery: Choose the Riesz dual direction u_j with inner(u_j,B_l)=delta_jl. Then integral a_Nj = integral rho_N*inner(u_j,x).
own_constructive_route.coefficient_limit: The actual rho_N converges everywhere to the strict cell indicator. Gaussian first-moment dominated convergence yields integral a_Nj -> inner(u_j,rawWinningMoment)=the already constructed facet flux w_j.
own_constructive_route.upper_limit: The derivative norm is at most sum a_Nj*norm(B_j). The resulting upper bounding integrals converge to sum w_j*norm(B_j), the proved genuine erosion perimeter.
own_constructive_route.BV_transfer: For each compact Gaussian test field, use the proved smooth-test identity and dominated convergence to bound its cell divergence integral by that limiting facet sum. Taking the supremum proves only the needed BV upper bridge.
own_constructive_route.remaining_separate_problem: This route does not prove the sharp equal-mass Gaussian BV cluster lower bound. No such theorem is registered as an axiom.
